topic: The Roman emperor who officially declared war on the ocean
hook: A Roman emperor declared war on the sea — and won.
script: A Roman emperor declared war on the sea — and won. Emperor Caligula marched his army to the English Channel, ordered them to attack the waves with spears, then declared victory. He collected seashells as war trophies. Sent them to Rome as proof of conquest. Historians still debate whether it happened. The shells were real. Follow for history moments that prove power drives people mad.
